title: 捏成何形
lyrics:
Song Title: 塑形 (Mold Me)
Style:
textacoustic folk with emotional Mandarin vocals, soft fingerstyle guitar, warm and intimate, bilingual (Mandarin + English), melancholic but beautiful, gentle rasgueado style with building emotion, 78 BPM
Lyrics
lyrics[Intro]
[guitarra acústica rasgueada, tono brillante y cálido]

[Verse 1]
我是一块软软的黏土 (Wǒ shì yī kuài ruǎn ruǎn de nián tǔ)
So mold me, do what you want
你想把我捏成什么样 (Nǐ xiǎng bǎ wǒ niē chéng shén me yàng)
I’ll become whatever you need
你知道怎么做 (Nǐ zhī dào zěn me zuò)
所以就动手吧 (Suǒ yǐ jiù dòng shǒu ba)
Turn me into something you love

[Chorus]
为什么你总要改变我 (Wèi shén me nǐ zǒng yào gǎi biàn wǒ)
I become your sickness, I become your curse
我不需要你靠近 (Wǒ bù xū yào nǐ kào jìn)
So this won’t tempt you anymore
我猜我从来都不是 (Wǒ cāi wǒ cóng lái dōu bù shì)
The one you wanted me to be
所以改变我吧 (Suǒ yǐ gǎi biàn wǒ ba)
Just mold me… please you

[Verse 2]
我是一块软软的黏土 (Wǒ shì yī kuài ruǎn ruǎn de nián tǔ)
So shape me however you like
你想让我变成谁 (Nǐ xiǎng ràng wǒ biàn chéng shéi)
I’ll try to be that guy
可我越来越不像自己 (Kě wǒ yuè lái yuè bù xiàng zì jǐ)
I’m losing who I am inside

[Chorus]
为什么你总要改变我 (Wèi shén me nǐ zǒng yào gǎi biàn wǒ)
I become your sickness, I become your curse
我不需要你靠近 (Wǒ bù xū yào nǐ kào jìn)
So this won’t tempt you anymore
我猜我从来都不是 (Wǒ cāi wǒ cóng lái dōu bù shì)
The one you wanted me to be
所以改变我吧 (Suǒ yǐ gǎi biàn wǒ ba)
Just mold me… please you

[Bridge – English focus]
I’m just clay in your hands
You keep pressing, I don’t understand
You want perfect, but I’m breaking
Every time you reshape me, I’m fading

[Final Chorus – Bilingual]
为什么你总要改变我 (Wèi shén me nǐ zǒng yào gǎi biàn wǒ)
I become your sickness… I become your curse
所以改变我吧 (Suǒ yǐ gǎi biàn wǒ ba)
Just mold me…
Please you…

[Outro]
[guitarra se hace más lenta y se desvanece]
塑我… (Sù wǒ…)
Mold me…
